summary: Use shared assistant error presentation for native stop outcomes

replay.detail: Native transcript outcomes remain normalized on owner reads; no replay trigger changes.

schema.detail: No database migration or stored transcript class changes.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: Supersedes the push_omp_stop description in native-outcomes.json: assistant stops use main's existing assistant_error view, not separate system errors. The client schema gains an additive open view.native diagnostics object retaining exact stopReason, errorMessage, errorStatus, errorId and retryRecovery values. The typed session-exit view is optional and may be omitted when its required native fields are absent; raw checkpoint values remain available in details or detail and the raw record. Raw provider error text becomes visible to timeline readers authorized by the existing read.projections scope, including through exact owner reads. Superseded attempts, silent aborts and user interrupts keep main's hidden presentation; length and unknown stops remain visible. Session exits retain the previously described cancelled status or fatal/unknown diagnostic errors, and timeline kinds remain unchanged. Older strict JSON-schema clients must update to the matching generated contract. This applies directly from main or from earlier native-outcomes branch builds, with no intermediate data migration required.

downtime.detail: No extra service interruption beyond normal binary restart.

manual.detail: No manual data or configuration changes.

recovery.detail: Preserve owner-local native transcripts; no additional recovery procedure.
